description.value: Pho An Nam is a Vietnamese restaurant in Richmond serving traditional dishes including phở and spring rolls made with fresh ingredients and homemade sauces. It is one of two locations (the other in Surrey) and offers online ordering for takeout. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's commercial Number 3 Road corridor could stop here for a hot, filling meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Richmond location at 6820 No. 3 Rd matches the OSM record, and provides a phone number ((604) 279-9097) absent from OSM tags. Prominent 'Order Online' buttons on the website confirm takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
